{{Top|leg}}
'''Ballistic shielding''' was an enhancement that increased the protection capabilities of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] against many types of physical injury. The Mark I, II, and III versions in turn allowed for a minor increase in protection.

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords|''KotOR II'']], this upgrade can be used on all types of armor, except for robes.
